service_saasMultiTenant.name: Multi-tenant SaaS platform (custom build)

service_saasMultiTenant.description: We build a fully custom multi-tenant SaaS platform for your company with your branding, integrations and business rules. We hand over the source code, you host it anywhere and you own it. Optionally we keep maintaining it monthly.
